messages:
Eli Torres: Quick heads-up: found a dead external link in /kb/infra/compilation.md that points to a gist with the benchmarking table. gist.github.com/old-benchmarks returns 404 in staging.
link-checker-bot: auto-scan: /kb/infra/compilation.md -> 404 on https://gist.github.com/old-benchmarks (external) and anchor #perf-table -> missing target.
Priya Shah: Ugh, that's the benchmark we used in the runtime kernels post. Is the gist archived?
Max Liu: That gist was moved last year when we consolidated benchmarks. I think the new canonical is https://gist.github.com/redwood/compiled-benchmarks-2025 but docs still reference the old slug.
Eli Torres: Can someone patch the doc to the new gist and fix the anchor to #summary-table? Small change, low risk. Also the image /assets/bench/throughput.png shows up as 403 in staging for me.
Olivia (docs-intern): I can do the sed and open a PR if you want me to. Never done a CODEOWNERS change though.
Dana (docs-bot): Suggested label: docs/quick-fix. Reminder: interns should ping a reviewer for OWNER edits.
Max Liu: @Olivia that would be great. Please include a short note about why the external link changed and add 'fixes #link-scan' in the PR body. Keep CODEOWNERS unchanged; just update refs.
Priya Shah: For the 403 on /assets/bench/throughput.png, we should rehost to the kb CDN path (/cdn/kb/bench/throughput.png). If we need a fallback quickly, we can add the nginx redirect: 
```
location ~ ^/assets/bench/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /cdn/kb/bench/$1;
}
```
Max Liu: +1 for 302 short window. We'll follow up with a permanent rehost.
Olivia (docs-intern): Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 - small replace for gist URL and anchor + image path updated to /cdn/kb/bench/throughput.png. Assigning @Max for review.
Eli Torres: Thanks Olivia. @link-checker-bot can you schedule a re-scan after PR merge and drop results in this thread?
link-checker-bot: Scheduled re-scan post-merge. Will post results to #docs when done. :robot_face:
Priya Shah: Quick QA note: please validate the anchor actually exists in the new gist (it does, #summary-table).
Max Liu: I'll review and merge once CI passes. If anyone sees other stale external slugs in /kb/infra/ call them out and I can batch a small sweep later today.
Eli Torres: Appreciate it. Demo team said they hit this during a dry-run; will confirm when green.
